outcome: mothers' recommendation of vaginal birth to other women
reasons for recommending vaginal birth (positive birth experience, postpartum comfort, beliefs and values, body image, sexual life)
cohort: 14 mothers who had a vaginal birth with midwives and recommended it to other women.
finding: Vaginal birth is mainly recommended to other women for emotional, medical, religious, and socio-cultural reasons, including pleasure/excitement, birth satisfaction, absence of interventions, early physical activity, early discharge, beliefs/values, body image, and early/safe sex life.
mod_finding: Mothers who experienced midwifery-led vaginal births recommend it to other women primarily for emotional, medical, religious, and socio-cultural reasons, encompassing positive birth experiences, postpartum comfort, body image, and sexual life.
